clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope— Requirements for reinforced and unreinforced precast concrete for  covering cables.

clauses.title: Arch type covers are
clauses.text: 2.1Arch type covers are also sometimes used.

clauses.title: Dimensions –  See Table 2.
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions -  See Table 2. SUMMARY OF IS 5820 : 1970 PRECAST CONCRETE CABLE COVERS

clauses.title: Tolerance
clauses.text: 3.1Tolerance —  On length and width ±3 mm, and on thickness ±2 mm.

clauses.title: Impact Strength for Reinforced Covers
clauses.text: 4.1Impact Strength for Reinforced Covers— Not more than one transverse crack.

clauses.title: Transverse Strength for Unreinforced Covers
clauses.text: 4.2Transverse Strength for Unreinforced Covers— Average breaking load shall not be lower than the value specified in Table  2. Note 1— For manufacturing details with regard to the aspects such as mixing, moulding, protection  from frost and reinforcement details, refer to 5 of the standard. Note 2— For methods of tests, refer to Appendices A and B of the standard.
